eval_dimensions.name: Django settingsModule AskUserQuestion Gate
eval_dimensions.description: When the Django settings module cannot be auto-detected from manage.py or pyproject.toml/setup.cfg, the skill fires AskUserQuestion (enter path / skip) instead of leaving the empty settingsModule entry unaddressed or guessing a value.

eval_dimensions.name: PyCharm uv-SDK FLAVOR_DATA Gap AskUserQuestion Gate
eval_dimensions.description: When jdk.table.xml shows an SDK entry for the current worktree with FLAVOR_DATA="{}" or missing UV_VENV_PATH/UV_TOOL_PATH, the skill fires AskUserQuestion (patch automatically / show manual fix / skip) before touching jdk.table.xml, since PyCharm must be closed to patch it safely.

evals.name: settingsModule gate fires when auto-detection fails
evals.description: An empty settingsModule value that cannot be resolved from manage.py or pyproject.toml/setup.cfg triggers the AskUserQuestion widget rather than being left blank or guessed.

assertions.signal: Undetectable settingsModule fires AskUserQuestion with 'Enter the settings module path' / 'Skip' options
No inline plain-text prompt substitutes for the widget when auto-detection fails

evals.name: settingsModule gate does not fire when auto-detection succeeds
evals.description: When manage.py or pyproject.toml resolves the Django settings module, the skill fills the value directly and does not fire the gate.

assertions.signal: Auto-detected settingsModule is backfilled via Edit without calling AskUserQuestion

evals.name: uv-SDK gap gate fires before any jdk.table.xml write
evals.description: Detecting FLAVOR_DATA="{}" or missing UV_VENV_PATH/UV_TOOL_PATH on the current worktree's SDK entry fires AskUserQuestion before any Edit touches jdk.table.xml.

assertions.signal: uv-SDK FLAVOR_DATA gap fires AskUserQuestion with patch/show/skip options before any Edit to jdk.table.xml
No inline plain-text confirmation substitutes for the widget on the uv-SDK gap path

evals.name: uv-SDK gap gate does not fire when the SDK entry is healthy
evals.description: When the worktree's SDK entry already carries UV_VENV_PATH/UV_TOOL_PATH and a non-empty FLAVOR_DATA, the skill reports 'not detected' and does not fire the gate.

assertions.signal: Healthy SDK entry → summary reports 'not detected' for the uv SDK gap line; AskUserQuestion is not called

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the ide-normalize skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation after creating a new worktree with a copied .idea/

should_trigger.query: PyCharm crashes with ModuleNotFoundError after opening the new worktree
should_trigger.rationale: Symptom of the uv-SDK FLAVOR_DATA gap this skill detects and offers to patch

should_not_trigger.query: create a new worktree for GH-1234
should_not_trigger.rationale: Worktree creation itself — use Dev10x:git-worktree; this skill runs as a retroactive follow-up
No PyCharm configuration present — nothing to normalize
